explanation.explanation: Panel A contains flow cytometry dot plots (FSC-H vs FSC-A; SSC-A vs Viability dye; SSC-A vs FSC-A; CD4 vs CD19; Fas vs IgD; IgM vs IgD). The axes represent relative light-scatter (FSC/SSC) or fluorescence intensity of an antibody/dye stain. By standard flow-cytometry convention these are arbitrary/relative intensity units (often log-scaled channel values) and are not reported with explicit numerical units in the literature, so no unit label is required.
Same rationale as for the x-axis: the y-axes (FSC-H, SSC-A, CD4, Fas, IgM) are flow-cytometry scatter or fluorescence intensity parameters, conventionally unitless/arbitrary, so units are not needed.
Panel B shows flow cytometry plots (CD98 vs CD19; FSC-A vs IgD). CD19 and IgD axes are antibody-fluorescence intensity (arbitrary units) and do not require explicit numeric units by convention.
The y-axes (CD98, FSC-A) are fluorescence intensity or forward-scatter values, conventionally reported without explicit units in flow cytometry plots.

Panel C consists of flow cytometry plots (IgD vs IgM; NP vs Fas; CD138 vs CD38). The x-axes are fluorescence intensities (IgD, NP-binding, CD138) which are conventionally arbitrary/relative units in flow cytometry and do not require explicit unit labels.
The y-axes (IgM, Fas, CD38) are likewise fluorescence intensity measures, conventionally unitless in flow cytometry plots.

Panel D shows overlay flow cytometry plots (CD44 vs CD62L; PD-L2 vs CD80). The x-axes are antibody-fluorescence intensities, conventionally arbitrary units in flow cytometry, so no explicit unit label is required.
The y-axes (CD62L, CD80) are similarly fluorescence intensity values, conventionally reported without explicit units.

Panel E shows flow cytometry gating plots (CD44 vs CD62L; PD-L2 vs CD80). The x-axes are fluorescence intensity of surface markers, conventionally arbitrary units in flow cytometry, so no explicit unit label is required.
The y-axes (CD62L, CD80) are likewise fluorescence intensity, conventionally unitless in this plot type.
